lesson.title: Emergencies in the news
lesson.title_ar: حالات الطوارئ في الصحافة: قراءة أخبار الحوادث وبناء شبكة المفردات

lines: Read the newspaper articles below and match them to two of these headlines.
2) DRIVERS INJURED IN HIGHWAY CRASH AND FIRE

Article 1: Alia Nawaz, 18, was badly injured yesterday in a horrific accident in Harib Street. Walking home from school at 1.30, she was hit by a blue Suzuki jeep which drove straight on. Police Officer Ali Aziz, on his way back to 22 May Street Police Station form highway patrol, arrived first on the scene. He immediately called an ambulance for Alia, who had a broken leg and a back injury. Aziz says, ‘ This man must be caught. If you saw the incident, please phone 08 111111 immediately.’

Article 2: Mother of two Mrs Khalifa Al-Yamani, her son Amri, 5, and daughter Shareefa, 2, were rescued yesterday from a fire at their flat in Medina Road. The fire was seen by husband Mustapha when he was returning from work at 2.00. After calling the fire service on his mobile, he rushed to the rescue. He was soon joined by two fire engines from Medina Road Fire Station. Mustapha, helped by Fire Officer Nasser Badawi, quickly carried his wife and children to safety. They were taken by ambulance to hospital, where Mrs Yamani was treated for burns on her arms.
Now do activities A and B in the Workbook.

ملاحظات نقل حرفي ومعاينة (PB p. 41):
1) الخبر الأول: طُبعت عبارة Station form highway patrol (form خطأً مطبعياً بدل from)، ووُجدت مسافة زائدة بعد علامة التنصيص في ‘ This man، وقد حُفظ النص المطبوع حرفياً.
2) الخبر الثاني: ورد مدمجاً كصورة داخل ملف PDF الرسمي، وجرى استخراجه والتحقق منه حرفاً بحرف عبر تكبير 600 DPI.
3) العنوان الأوسط الزائد (DRIVERS INJURED IN HIGHWAY CRASH AND FIRE) يخص حادث الدرس التالي 6.2.

interactive_spot.label: مطابقة العناوين وتفكيك مفردات خدمات الطوارئ (PB ص 41)

simple_explain.html:
• الخبر الأول ← HIT-AND-RUN DRIVER INJURES STUDENT (hit-and-run: حادث صدم وهروب السائق دون توقف).
  • الخبر الثاني ← FAMILY SAVED FROM BURNING HOME (إنقاذ الأم وطفليها من حريق الشقة في شارع المدينة).
  • ملاحظة اسمية في الخبر الثاني: بدأ الخبر بـ Mrs Khalifa Al-Yamani ثم اختصر في الجملة الأخيرة إلى Mrs Yamani.

example.html: Word clue: mobile (= mobile phone), highway patrol (دورية الطرق السريعة), and paramedics (مسعفو الطوارئ) appear in this unit's Wordlist (WB p. 113).

activities.prompt_literal: 6.1 A Read the two newspaper stories on PB page 41 and write short answers to these questions.
activities.prompt_ar: اقرأ خبري الصحيفة في PB ص 41 وأجب بإجابات قصيرة عن الأسئلة الخمسة (WB ص 71):

items.question: 1 When did each incident happen?
items.model_answer: Story 1 (car accident): yesterday at 1.30. Story 2 (flat fire): yesterday at 2.00.
items.explain_ar: ورد التوقيت (yesterday at 1.30 / at 2.00) في كل خبر.

items.question: 2 Which emergency services came to each emergency?
items.model_answer: Story 1: Police Force (Police Officer Ali Aziz) and ambulance / medical services. Story 2: Fire Service (two fire engines & Fire Officer Nasser Badawi) and ambulance / medical services.
items.explain_ar: الشرطة والإسعاف في الأول، والإطفاء والإسعاف في الثاني.

items.question: 3 What do you know about the people who were helped?
items.model_answer: Story 1: Alia Nawaz, an 18-year-old student walking home from school in Harib Street. Story 2: Mother of two Mrs Khalifa Al-Yamani, her son Amri (aged 5), and her daughter Shareefa (aged 2), living in a flat in Medina Road.
items.explain_ar: الأسماء والأعمار والصفة كما وردت في الخبرين.

items.question: 4 Which of them were injured and how badly?
items.model_answer: Alia Nawaz was badly injured (broken leg and a back injury). Mrs Yamani was treated in hospital for burns on her arms (her two children were unhurt).
items.explain_ar: إصابات عالية بالغة، وإصابة السيدة اليماني بحروق في ذراعيها.

items.question: 5 What do you know about the people who helped them?
items.model_answer: Story 1: Police Officer Ali Aziz from 22 May Street Police Station, who was returning from highway patrol and first arrived on the scene. Story 2: Husband Mustapha (who was returning from work, called the fire service on his mobile, and helped carry his family out) and Fire Officer Nasser Badawi from Medina Road Fire Station.
items.explain_ar: صفات المنقذين ومقرات عملهم من النص.

hints: افصل دائماً بين تفاصيل الخبر الأول (عالية نواز) والخبر الثاني (أسرة اليماني).

activities.prompt_literal: 6.1 B Networks can help you collect and learn vocabulary. Add words from the newspaper stories to this network. Add other words you know.
activities.prompt_ar: أكمل شبكة مفردات خدمات الطوارئ الثلاث من الخبرين وما تعرفه (WB ص 71):

items.prompt: EMERGENCY SERVICES → medical services → person/people: paramedics (printed); extra: doctors, nurses · vehicle(s): ______
EMERGENCY SERVICES → medical services → place(s): ______ (also: clinic)
EMERGENCY SERVICES → fire service (middle branch; vehicle printed: fire engine) → person/people: ______
EMERGENCY SERVICES → fire service (middle branch) → place(s): ______
EMERGENCY SERVICES → police force (place printed: police station) → vehicle(s): ______

hints: المطبوع أصلاً في المخطط: paramedics وfire engine وpolice station؛ أما الفرع الأوسط فغير معنون فوقه بكلمة 'fire service' في الطباعة.

questions.stem: In the second clipping on PB page 41, who first spotted the fire and called the fire service?

options.text: Husband Mustapha, when he was returning from work at 2.00.
Police Officer Ali Aziz, on his way back from highway patrol.
options.why_wrong: الضابط علي عزيز هو من باشر حادث دهس عالية في شارع حريب.

options.text: Fire Officer Nasser Badawi from inside the burning flat.
options.why_wrong: رجل الإطفاء ناصر بدوي وصل بسيارتي الإطفاء من محطة شارع المدينة وساعد في الإنقاذ.
عمري طفل في الخامسة من عمره أُنقذ مع والدته وأخته.

hints: انظر جملة: The fire was seen by husband Mustapha...
